svg.title: Taelgar continental pressure and winds — northern summer
svg.desc: Low-detail schematic on the Taelgar continental basemap. Red H marks broad high pressure; blue L marks broad low pressure or recurring lows. Faint contours suggest relative spatial extent, without assigned pressure values or fixed edges. Purple arrows show where air travels; dashed arrows show episodic cold outbreaks. Symbols and arrows indicate seasonal tendencies. North is up. Small basemap hexes measure 24 miles face to face.

g.text: Ocean highs farther north · Warm interior lows · Maritime summer inflow
Air travels in the arrow direction
Faint rings suggest relative extent; their spacing does not indicate wind strength.
Pressure symbols mark recurring tendencies; contours have no assigned values or fixed edges.
Same basemap extent in both seasons · North up · Small hexes: 24 miles face to face
